sloka: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा राघवः सुसमाहितः ।उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षं पुरन्दरम् ।। ७.७६.९ ॥
transliteration: devānāṁ bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā rāghavaḥ susamāhitaḥ ।uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ sahasrākṣaṁ purandaram ।। 7.76.9 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the gods, Rama, composed and with folded hands, spoke to Indra, the thousand-eyed destroyer of cities.
